import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

seeds = ['s42', 's43', 's44']
fol_isr = [0.123, 0.0, 0.57]
fol_pr = [0.93, 0.14, 0.98]
prolog_isr = [0.031, 0.008, 0.081]
prolog_pr = [0.83, 0.56, 0.21]

fol_color = '#0072B2'
prolog_color = '#D55E00'

x = np.arange(len(seeds))
width = 0.32

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

bars_fol = ax.bar(x - width/2, fol_isr, width, label='FOL (Prover9)', color=fol_color, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
bars_prolog = ax.bar(x + width/2, prolog_isr, width, label='Prolog (SWI-Prolog)', color=prolog_color, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

for i, (bar, pr) in enumerate(zip(bars_fol, fol_pr)):
    label = f'PR={pr:.2f}'
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.015, label,
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color=fol_color)

for i, (bar, pr) in enumerate(zip(bars_prolog, prolog_pr)):
    label = f'PR={pr:.2f}'
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.015, label,
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color=prolog_color)

# tautological annotation for s44 FOL
ax.annotate('†tautological', xy=(2 - width/2, 0.57), xytext=(1.15, 0.62),
            fontsize=7, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=0.8))

fol_mean = np.mean(fol_isr)
fol_mean_excl = np.mean([0.123, 0.0])
prolog_mean = np.mean(prolog_isr)

ax.axhline(fol_mean, color=fol_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.5)
ax.axhline(prolog_mean, color=prolog_color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.5)

ax.text(2.55, fol_mean + 0.01, f'FOL mean', fontsize=7, color=fol_color, alpha=0.7)
ax.text(2.55, prolog_mean + 0.01, f'Prolog mean', fontsize=7, color=prolog_color, alpha=0.7)

textbox = (
    f'FOL mean ISR: {fol_mean:.3f}\n'
    f'  (excl. s44†: {fol_mean_excl:.3f})\n'
    f'Prolog mean ISR: {prolog_mean:.3f}\n'
    'Both near-zero →\n'
    'cross-logic diagnostic transfer'
)
props = dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#F5F5F5', edgecolor='#CCCCCC', alpha=0.9)
ax.text(0.97, 0.97, textbox, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=7,
        verticalalignment='top', horizontalalignment='right', bbox=props)

ax.set_xlabel('Seed')
ax.set_ylabel('ISR')
ax.set_title('FOL vs Prolog: Exec-Only ISR Comparison')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(seeds)
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.7)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

outpath = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_3/projects/solver-trace-ablation/figures/paper/fig4_prolog_comparison.pdf'
fig.savefig(outpath, format='pdf')
plt.close(fig)
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
